kind: Predeclared single-factor fused-baseline development trial, round 2 trial A (development only)
round: round 2 (coordinator-admitted: at most 3 single-factor trials targeting the policy log-prob drift mechanism)

order_rationale.A_reference_kl_first: Trial-2/3 drift is cumulative across windows and reward-independent; a KL anchor to the frozen initial policy is a restoring force against cumulative drift. Joint PPO had no native KL/reference mechanism (only GRPO/NFT), so a minimal opt-in anchor was implemented (a89c4509).
order_rationale.B_target_kl_deferred: Per-window drift is tiny (trial 2: ratio_mean ~1.0008, PPO clip fraction ~0.3%); a per-window approx-KL early stop would rarely trigger and cannot bound cumulative drift. approx_kl is not logged by the native trainer.
order_rationale.C_logprob_scale_deferred: The log-prob is a sum over 8x7=56 Gaussian cells of one selected denoising transition (model/ppo.py selected_transition_logprobs), which explains grad norm ~40-50. But the actor update uses AdamW after global-norm clipping, both of which are invariant to a constant loss scale (eps 1e-8 negligible), so dividing the log-prob by 56 would not change update magnitude; dividing inside the ratio would only loosen PPO clipping further. Predicted no effect; not run unless A fails for a reason that implicates it.

factor: model.ppo_reference_kl_beta 0 -> 10 (KL(pi_theta || pi_init) of the scored transition added to the joint loss with weight 10)
beta_rationale: Per cell, the PPO surrogate gradient on the transition mean is O(|A|/std) and the KL gradient is beta*delta/std^2, so the anchor balances noise-driven drift at a mean offset delta ~ std/beta. beta=10 bounds the deterministic-ODE mean shift to ~0.1 std per scored cell (~0.014-0.05 latent units across denoise indices), small enough to allow targeted change on tasks 8/9.
unchanged: actor lr 1e-6, value_lr 1e-4, native LIBERO-10 profile (8 envs on 8 GPUs, global_minibatch 32, 4 updates per 128-decision window), value_feature_gradient default (true), fused AdamW fp32_master, clip 1.0, betas/eps/decay, checkpoint, aligned_200, seed 17
source: a89c4509 on top of feat/quantized-optimizers @ 94f532c8 (includes the Joint PPO memory fix)
quality_bar: PASS iff every completed aligned_200 evaluation at update >= 80 (80, 160, 240, 320) has success >= 0.885 (>= 177/200) AND mean episode_steps <= 339.10. Any failing evaluation FAILS the trial (cancel). The update-320 evaluation must complete for a pass.
gain_criterion: Real gain iff, against this run's own update-0 evaluation, update-320 overall success rises by >= 0.02 (>= 4 episodes; twice the observed +/-1-point frozen variability) OR tasks 8+9 combined rise by >= 4 of 40. A pass without gain is reported as stable-non-improving and does not lock the protocol.
integrity_check: Mean reference_kl over window 1 < 1e-3 (policy equals reference at the start); otherwise the reference construction is wrong and the trial is stopped as invalid.
mechanism_prediction: Mean per-decision reference_kl plateaus: its mean over windows 61-80 is at most 2x its mean over windows 21-40; and success stays within the quality bar where trial 2 (same lr, no anchor) fell to 0.860 by update 240.
falsification: Anchoring hypothesis falsified if the quality bar fails, or if reference_kl keeps growing (> 2x between those window ranges) while quality falls.
